editorial:
Ever wonder if your local fast food mascot is actually a psycho? You get to find out in this wild ride where a high school kid discovers that the friendly clown at the drive-thru is actually a killer. It starts off feeling like a typical teen movie, but it quickly turns into a chaotic fight for survival. You will feel the tension as the main character tries to warn everyone in town while the clown turns the restaurant into a house of horrors. It is the kind of movie that does not take itself too seriously, making it a great pick for a Friday night with friends.

The pacing is fast and the gore is over-the-top, which adds to the fun. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, it actually fits the campy vibe of the story. If you love movies that mix laughs with scares, you will really enjoy this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you are a collector, grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep on your shelf. It is a low-stress watch that delivers exactly what it promises.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a big showdown between the student and the killer clown. After a series of chases and scares, the main character manages to outsmart the clown using the tools found in the kitchen. In the end, the clown is defeated in a messy, violent way that puts a stop to the killing spree. The town is finally safe, and the nightmare at the drive-thru ends for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy horror movies and killer clowns.
